import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.FGAPicRepresentability
open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry

-- WITHOUT PicEtSeparated in scope: is there ANOTHER in-tree route to field 3
-- for an arbitrary representing X, given the extra GeometricallyIntegral binder?
example {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]
    {X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))}
    (rep : (Scheme.PicScheme.picEt C).RepresentableBy X) :
    IsSeparated X.hom := by
  exact?

-- and does clause (1) itself already hold (sorry-reachably) via the gate?
example {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] :
    ∃ X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)),
      Nonempty ((Scheme.PicScheme.picEt C).RepresentableBy X) ∧
        LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom ∧ IsSeparated X.hom :=
  ⟨Scheme.PicSchemeEt C, ⟨Scheme.representableEt C⟩, inferInstance, inferInstance⟩
